label: 星序博士・向上跑步及待機起停轉跳16格八欄原畫分件

provenance.method: Each own native up pose independently partitioned; built-in image_gen supplies concealed garment material, cap-under hair and socked underclothes. No reflection, reused other-pose mask, skeletal replacement or whole-person deformation.
provenance.normalIdentity: Visible own-native hair, neck, ears, face and hands retain their RGBA; invisible rear-view regions are recorded as occluded, not fabricated.
provenance.clothAlphaCleanup: Original near-opaque cloth alpha may be promoted from >=240 to255; original visible RGB and native source atlases are retained.
provenance.compact: Same-source LANCZOS 0.375 resize; non-body passes clear only resized body-front alpha>=248 identity core. Antialias edges may blend naturally.
provenance.frontItemsOnRearView: handheld and accessory remain their true front items, naturally occluded by the body; native rear cape fasteners remain cape detail.
provenance.fallback: Exact actual-loadout fallback for unsupported left/right cells, foreign items and failed current cells; down assets and load race/fallback code remain unchanged.
